title: Single hieratic sign, D. Assiut N13.1 TN33 (AKU HT 28154)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 28154

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 28154; AKU grapheme D0130 (AKU GR 128). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: D4 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 82, 82bis. Occurrence: line 9; find place Gebel Assiut al-gharbi; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 4.5 x 19.8 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Ursula Verhoeven. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
